name: Josette: Death of a Star
source:
The game is set in the year of 1959 where you play as Sergeant Cosette, a detective and the estranged twin sister of the late nation's star; Josette Bellange. Disguise as your late sister, indulge yourself in a toxic romance with the suspects, and seek out the truth behind her death in this murder mystery otome game. 

[From [url=https://underscoreprojekt.itch.io/josette-death-of-a-star]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
游戏背景设定在1959年，你扮演Cosette中士，一名侦探，也是已故国家明星关系疏远的双胞胎姐妹；乔赛特·贝兰热.伪装成已故的妹妹，沉溺于与嫌疑人的有毒浪漫之中，并在这款谋杀之谜乙女游戏中找出她死亡背后的真相。

[来自[url=https://underscoreprojekt.itch.io/josette-death-of-a-star]itch.io[/url]]
